panels.description: HIMALAYAS, 2042 at night: Roman hangs half-buried in a blue-white crevasse as his small silver TJ descends and lightning strikes the glacier and sensor housing. Leave upper area clear.

HIMALAYAS, 2026: floodwater carries a cooking pot and child’s red sweater past six-year-old Sitara seen from behind on a stone step as an adult hand pulls her away. Keep faces and cultural details nonspecific; leave upper area clear.

ANTARCTICA, 2046: Sitara in her red jacket stands beside Nayah in yellow; warning flags divide them from a buried sensor tripod. Sitara’s separate TJ crouches by the route marker. Leave upper third clear.
Sitara’s boot hovers before the flagged line; the sensor’s red light blinks while a geometric tremor advances beneath the ice. Leave upper-left for the sound effect and lower-left for dialogue.
